module Main where -- entry
import Data.List (sort)
data Shape = Circle Double | Square Int
area :: Shape -> Double
area (Circle r) = pi * r * r {- nested {- inner -} -}
main = putStrLn ("area: " ++ show (area (Circle 1.5)))
